composition_variation: Create a refined watercolor anime portrait of adult Sakura Haruno enjoying tea in a small spring garden. Preserve her short pink hair, green eyes, and small forehead diamond. Dress her in a fully covering burgundy long-sleeve blouse and cream trousers. She sits upright on a narrow wooden bench, holding a small ceramic cup with both hands close to her lap. Use pale cherry petals, sage green foliage, rose-colored shadows, soft morning sunlight, and an uncluttered sky opening above. Design for native 1024x1536 portrait format: important forms inside x158..866, faces inside x240..784. Leave the upper 28 percent quiet for the lock-screen clock. Use an original composition, no copied frames or promotional layout, text, logos, UI, weapons, fighting, extra characters, or distorted anatomy.
